snip.cap: Beaumanor copy of D34, Mogilev, 27 February 1942: the preamble, the discriminator DNOSX and the first cipher groups
snip.credit: NARA, RG 457, HCC, Box 1386, GPD 665 item 3, via Weierud (CryptoCellar, 2020)

system: Doppelkasten: double Playfair with two 5x5 boxes, plaintext in double lines of 17, each pair enciphered twice through the same boxes; one daily key of 27 Feb 1942 (four discriminators).
